pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-07.png with Read and looked at it before reading any other document. The image loaded and was readable. It shows 4 panels: a top row of two, a wide middle panel and a tall wide bottom panel. There are placeholders for ravi, specialist, partner, child, meera and ananya, and several teal labels.
pages.observation: My reading order was P1 caption 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.' (ravi). Next came P2, with the label 'WELBUK VISION' (top-left), the specialist, then the caption 'The vision: trusted connections between clinics, specialists, and patients across locations.' Then P3, with the label 'WELBUK VISION' again, then 'One connected ecosystem for care and family wellness.' beside ravi, partner and child. Last was P4, with the label 'Welbuk Practice • Welbuk Care • Welbuk Health' (top-right) above meera, ananya and ravi, then the bottom caption 'Welbuk — Building a connected healthcare ecosystem.' There are no spoken lines. Issues: (1) It is unclear whose voice 'us' and 'our hometown' are in P1: Ravi's thought, a narrator or the brand. (2) The specialist, partner and child appear for the first time with nothing to introduce them or show their relationship to Ravi, and nothing in the storyboard signals a different location for the specialist. (3) The 'WELBUK VISION' label appears twice in a row (P2 and P3), which is redundant. The P2 label also sits flush against or overlaps the panel border. (4) In P4 the label box overlaps Ravi's placeholder and label ('rav'), which could cover his face. (5) P4 leaves a large empty middle area between the figures and the bottom caption. (6) The page switches from story to pure brand messaging. It reads as an advertisement ending rather than a narrative close, so the transition from page 6 needs more than the word 'Tomorrow'.
